author: blu
body: Proves mana abilities: a card whose Oracle text says "{T}: Add {G}." (a mana dork or a Mox) compiles to a ManaAbility, and tapping the permanent puts that mana in its controller's pool. Sol Ring's "{T}: Add {C}{C}." makes two colourless. Choice sources ("Add {B} or {R}") exceed the single-colour model and are left unmodelled -- flagged, never silently the wrong colour.
